content.rendered:
Please find important information for incoming Kindergarten students in our Special Edition Newsletter.

We hope you are all enjoying summer. On August 7th, from 10-11 am, we will be hosting our 2nd kindergarten playdate on the Hawks View playground. This is completely optional, but a great way to meet other incoming kindergarteners and their families. Please join us if you’re in town and able!
